The objective of the Qatar Scholarship -EAA and Al Quds Bard College program is to provide
marginalized Palestinian youth and adults, refugees and students from historically underserved
communities with access to high-quality US-accredited and Palestinian-accredited
undergraduate and graduate education, which has the potential to transform the students' lives
as well as the lives of their families and communities, thereby resulting in widespread and
positive impacts over Palestinian institutions and schools and building the prospects for
leadership and self-governance.

At the undergraduate level, this project will result in:
•Young Palestinians equipped with the tools and knowledge to join the workforce and
shape discourse in the institutions in which they serve; or to pursue postgraduate study.
• Students with a strong sense of civic engagement, empowering them to become
productive and effective global citizens and agents of behavioral and positive change in
their communities.
At the graduate level, this project will result in:
• In-service teachers educated through pedagogically innovative student-centered
methodologies and fostering stronger critical thinking and reasoning skills in their
classrooms.
The creation of a core cadre of teachers who will continue to contribute to educational and
societal development and reform.
